## Conclusion

`FCHK` — INST_TYPE_DECOUPLED_RD_WR_SCBD, pipe `mio_pipe`; opcode(s) `0x302`, `0x902`, `0x1d02`, **3 CLASS** in the
sm_120 dump. Generated from the ISA description; the hardware behaviour of this mnemonic
